offering_description.value: Owns and operates casino resorts offering gaming, hotel rooms, dining, entertainment and spa services to leisure and gaming customers. Its properties are Atlantis Casino Resort Spa in Reno, Nevada and Monarch Casino Black Hawk in Colorado. Revenue comes from on-site gaming and hospitality.

primary_services.value: casino gaming; hotel lodging; food and beverage; entertainment; spa and convention services

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure guests, gamblers and hotel visitors in Reno and Black Hawk

end_markets.value: casino gaming; hospitality; leisure travel; entertainment

revenue_model.value: service fees: casino gaming from slots and table games; service fees: hotel rooms, food and beverage, spa, entertainment and other amenities

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs casino resort properties, selling gaming and hospitality directly to guests

specialization.value: related lines: gaming, hotel, dining and entertainment at two casino resorts

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Atlantis Reno and Black Hawk casino resorts; online: hotel bookings and promotions via own website
